title: GTA 6 launch trailer: Lucia calls Jason from jail 🌴
subject: gta6
description:
Did the launch trailer sell you on Jason and Lucia? 👇

Rockstar released the GTA 6 launch trailer on October 15, 2026: a 91-second look at Jason and Lucia's relationship, an easy score that goes wrong, and new music from Justice, who are composing the game's original score. Preloads begin November 12 and GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Game Informer (Oct 15, 2026), VICE (Oct 15, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 15, 2026), The Statesman (Oct 15, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Lucia calls Jason from jail in GTA 6's launch trailer.
Rockstar released the 91-second trailer on October 15, and it's all about the couple.
Jason's army past comes up, and an easy score goes wrong across Leonida.
French duo Justice is composing the original score, and the trailer debuts their song Flower in a Hurricane, with SZA and Tame Impala.
Preloads open November 12, a week before GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
